title: Zero-Click Content Machine
subtitle: Automate a week of content in one prompt
audience: creators and solo founders who sell digital products
description: A curated pack of prompts that turn one topic into a full content calendar: hooks, posts, and CTAs. Free starter pack.

prompts.title: The Content Matrix
prompts.prompt: You are a content strategist. Given TOPIC and AUDIENCE, output a 5-cell matrix: hook, bridge, value, proof, CTA. Be specific and non-generic.
prompts.example_output: A table with 5 filled rows, each tailored to the audience.

prompts.title: Voice Cloner
prompts.prompt: Here are 3 samples of my writing: [SAMPLES]. Extract the voice pattern (sentence length, tone, vocabulary) and rewrite: [NEW TEXT] in that voice.
prompts.example_output: Rewritten text + a 3-line voice pattern summary.

prompts.title: Hook Lab
prompts.prompt: Write 10 opening lines for a post about [TOPIC]. Rules: under 12 words, no cliches, each triggers a different emotion. Rank them.
prompts.example_output: 10 ranked hooks with the emotion each one triggers.

skills.title: Auto-title generator
steps: Paste 3 competitor titles into the prompt.
Ask the model to find the pattern (power words, numbers, curiosity gaps).
Generate 10 titles for YOUR topic in that pattern.
Pick the best with a second model pass.

code.snippet:
titles = ['3 titles here']
pattern = llm('what pattern?', titles)
new = llm(f'10 titles in this pattern: {pattern}', topic)
print(new)
code.explanation: Two-pass generation: pattern extraction, then creation.

skills.title: Daily post batcher
steps: Give the model your asset link and one topic.
Ask for 7 post variants across 4 formats (text, image idea, video script, question).
Request a different CTA angle per post.
Post one variant per day, staggered.

code.snippet:
posts = llm('7 variants for TOPIC, link: LINK', formats=['text','image','video','q'])
for p in posts: post(p)
code.explanation: Batch generation keeps voice consistent across the week.
